clauses.title: Scope – Covers the
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Covers the material, dimensions and sectional properties of aluminium unequal leg angles for structural use and other applications.

clauses.title: Designation – Aluminium unequal leg angles
clauses.text: 2. Designation - Aluminium unequal leg angles sections shall be designated as ALU followed by lengths SUMMARY OF IS 3909 : 1986 ALUMINIUM UNEQUAL LEG ANGLES (First  Revision) of longer and shorter legs and thickness of the section in mm. For example Alu 80 ×  60 × 6
